description: Enterprise Golden Q&A Benchmark Suite for candidate vector index evaluation and quality gate verification.

test_cases.question: Can I return an opened electronic item after 20 days?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: No. Standard electronics must be returned unopened within 14 days of delivery. Opened electronic items are strictly ineligible for return after 14 days unless verified defective under manufacturer warranty.

test_cases.question: What is the restocking fee for customer remorse returns on large furniture items?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: A standard 15% restocking fee applies to all customer remorse returns of bulky or oversized furniture, deducted from the total refund amount.

test_cases.question: How long does it take for a refund to post back to my original payment method after the warehouse receives my return?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Once the return package is received and inspected at our fulfillment center, refunds are processed within 3 to 5 business days, with bank posting taking an additional 2 to 3 business days.

test_cases.question: Can merchandise purchased as Final Sale or Clearance be returned for store credit?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: No. Items designated as Final Sale, Clearance, or Warehouse Liquidation cannot be returned, exchanged, or converted into store credit under any circumstances.

test_cases.question: How do gift returns work when the recipient does not have the original purchase receipt?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Gift recipients without an original receipt can return eligible items within 30 days for store credit, provided the order number or gift barcode is verified.

test_cases.question: What is the reporting window if a received product is defective on arrival (DOA)?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Defective on arrival items must be reported within 48 hours of carrier delivery confirmation to qualify for an immediate zero-cost expedited replacement.

test_cases.question: Who is responsible for return shipping costs on international orders?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: For international orders, customers are responsible for international return shipping postage, customs declarations, and any applicable import duties unless the return is due to warehouse error.

test_cases.question: What is the daily cutoff time for Next-Day Express shipping orders?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Next-Day Express orders must be placed and payment confirmed by 2:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST) Monday through Friday for same-day dispatch.

test_cases.question: Is an adult signature required upon delivery for orders exceeding $500 in value?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Yes. All shipments with a declared value exceeding $500 USD mandate direct adult signature upon delivery; carriers are prohibited from leaving packages unattended.

test_cases.question: Can oversized freight and appliances be shipped to standard PO Boxes?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: No. Oversized freight items, major appliances, and shipments over 70 pounds cannot be delivered to PO Boxes or APO/FPO addresses and require a valid physical street address.

test_cases.question: Will I receive separate tracking numbers if an order is fulfilled from multiple fulfillment warehouses?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Yes. When an order is split across multiple fulfillment centers, independent carrier tracking numbers are generated and emailed for each dispatch package.

test_cases.question: What is the carrier protocol if a customer package is deemed undeliverable due to an incorrect address?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Packages returned to sender due to incorrect addresses are received by the returns processing center, inspected, and refunded minus original carrier freight costs.

test_cases.question: Are delivery timelines and shipping surcharges different for shipments to Alaska and Hawaii?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Shipments to Alaska and Hawaii incur non-contiguous domestic freight surcharges and require an additional 3 to 7 business days transit time depending on destination geography.

test_cases.question: What is the default manufacturer limited warranty duration for consumer hardware devices?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: All new hardware devices include a 12-month manufacturer limited warranty covering defects in materials, assembly, and workmanship under normal operational use.

test_cases.question: Does the limited warranty cover liquid immersion, water damage, or cracked screens caused by accidental drops?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: No. The limited warranty explicitly excludes cosmetic damage, liquid spills or immersion, cracked display panels, and physical impact resulting from accidental drops.

test_cases.question: What documentation is required to transfer remaining warranty coverage to a secondary purchaser?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: To transfer warranty coverage, the claimant must provide the original authorized dealer sales receipt, serial number registration, and proof of secondary purchase transfer.

test_cases.question: Does opening the device chassis or installing unauthorized third-party firmware void the warranty?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Yes. Unauthorized disassembly, tampering with tamper-evident seals, hardware modifications, or flashing custom firmware voids all warranty coverage immediately.

test_cases.question: How are out-of-warranty hardware repairs priced and evaluated?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Out-of-warranty hardware repairs require a $49 non-refundable initial diagnostic evaluation fee, which is credited toward the approved repair estimate if service proceeds.

test_cases.question: Are replacement units supplied under warranty service guaranteed to be brand new or factory refurbished?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Warranty replacement units may be new or factory-certified refurbished devices that meet original performance and cosmetic standards, carrying the balance of the original warranty.

test_cases.question: Can loose or standalone lithium-ion batteries be shipped via commercial air freight?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: No. Standalone, loose, or unpackaged lithium-ion batteries are strictly prohibited on passenger and commercial air cargo flights pursuant to FAA, DOT, and IATA hazardous materials regulations.

test_cases.question: What shipping restrictions apply to aerosol sprays, pressurized cans, and flammable adhesives?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Pressurized aerosols and flammable adhesives are classified as UN1950 Limited Quantity commodities and can only be transported via ground freight with proper diamond hazard labeling.

test_cases.question: Can swollen, damaged, or recalled lithium batteries be sent through standard return mail?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Swollen, punctured, or recalled batteries are strictly banned from all postal and commercial parcel return services due to thermal runaway and fire risk; they must be disposed of at certified local hazardous waste facilities.

test_cases.question: Where can customers access official Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for chemical cleaning kits?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Official OSHA-compliant Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for all chemical kits and industrial solvents can be downloaded from our compliance repository or requested via regulatory support.

test_cases.question: What packaging and ventilation standards are mandated when shipping dry ice with biological specimens?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Dry ice packages must use vented outer insulated containers to prevent pressure buildup, feature UN1845 Class 9 diamond hazard labels, and declare exact net weight in kilograms.

test_cases.question: Can medical diagnostic kits containing biological reagents be exported internationally without regulatory permits?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: No. Diagnostic kits containing active reagents or biohazardous media require valid export clearance, destination customs import licenses, and declaration under ITAR/EAR regulations.
